report.clinical_summary: Patient diagnosed with Type 2 diabetes, experiencing increased thirst, frequent urination, fatigue, and blurred vision. Elevated blood sugar levels. Patient reports taking two daily medications (morning and bedtime) and has established a routine. Adherence is high, with no reported missed doses. Patient expresses significant emotional distress, feeling overwhelmed and worried about complications. Believes condition is lifelong and has changed their life substantially. Has mixed beliefs about personal control but trusts treatment and medical team.
